access.title: Content access
access.intro: Server-wide defaults for content restrictions. Restrictions for one person are set on their account page.

policy.title: Server policy
policy.blockUnrated: Hide unrated items under a rating ceiling
policy.blockUnratedImpact: Applies to accounts with a rating ceiling whose own setting is "Follow the server policy". Accounts without a ceiling are not affected.
policy.restrictAdminsImpact: When on, an administrator's own rating ceiling, blocked tags and item rules hide content from them as well. Library grants never restrict administrators.
policy.impact: Policy changes apply to every account's next request and are written to the audit log.

order.title: How visibility is decided
order.libraries: Library grants: a non-administrator never sees a library that is not granted. Nothing below widens this.
order.unrestricted: Accounts without restrictions, and administrators while the policy above is off, see everything granted.
order.rules: The nearest item rule on the item, its season or its series decides: hide hides, allow shows.
order.tags: A blocked tag or genre on the item or a parent hides it.
order.rating: Under a rating ceiling, a higher rating hides the item; items without a rating follow the unrated setting.
order.perUser: Ceilings, blocked tags and item rules are set per account:

ratings.title: Rating codes
ratings.intro: Ratings are read from the items' metadata. A bare age such as 16 or 16+ is also recognized; anything else counts as unrated.
ratings.caption: Recognized rating codes by level
